# THOUGHT Glyph Library — Third Set

This is the explicit **3rd Set** of the THOUGHT Glyph Library.

- Stable set ID: `inshell.thought.glyph-library.set-03`
- Set version: `1`
- Members: exactly **2** conventional-outline fonts
- Ordered members: `humanist-smooth`, `humanist-quantized`
- Repertoire: 76 characters per font, including metrics-only SPACE
- Status: `declared-with-metric-exception`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1

Both members passed visual review. Both retain a disclosed metric-contract exception: their visual baselines are approximately 5.6 rather than the baseline 7 used by Sets 1 and 2.

Open [gallery.html](gallery.html), then read [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md), [REVIEW.md](REVIEW.md), and [storage-model.json](storage-model.json).

Verify this bundle:

```sh
npm run verify
```

Install a vendored copy:

```sh
npm install ./vendor/thought-glyph-library-third-set
```
